newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ABS-CBN sees 1997 net at 1.8 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: ABS-CBN sees 1997 net at 1.8 bln pesos.

text.p: ABS-CBN Broadcasting Corp is expected to post 1.8 billion pesos in net profits this year from 1.53 billion pesos in 1996, company president Eugenio Lopez III told reporters on Wednesday.
ABS-CBN is the country's largest broadcasting company.
It earlier reported a net income of 248 million pesos in the first quarter of 1997, down from the adjusted figure of 291 million pesos in the year-earlier period.
It had earlier reported 1996 first quarter net income at 288 million pesos.
ABS-CBN said its 1997 first three months net was lower because advertisers had cancelled their orders in protest over a decision to hike prime time rates.
Revenues in the first quarter reached 1.03 billion pesos, up from 940 miillion pesos in the same period last year.
"The advertisers' boycott in February and March affected us adversely but we're on track now," Lopez said.
He said earnings in April were 40 to 50 million pesos above the budget for the month.
"We feel in the next three to four months we'll make up for the losses," he said.
ABS-CBN is poised to contruct more cinemas in the provinces, which would be a source of additional revenues.
The firm is also going more aggressively into shopping programmes that would entice overseas Filipinos to buy merchandise, he added.
